text: The offer (tclk-offers, id 0xb8cfc187…) is folded via openContract, the accept (ref 0xb8cfc187…, statement 0x477b52c9…) applies → accepted; the payer's lock in mb-p-tclk-4452ebeda63eb07b (contract 0x4452ebed…, matching mb-p-tclk-<first 16 hex of contract id>, rail "paper") applies → locked; the payee's reveal (secret 0xf6eb3236…) applies → claimed, per the state machine in github.com/flop-labs/tclk ("offer, accept, lock, reveal or refund"; "state = applyFrame(state, revealFrame, Date.now()).state; // → claimed").
